additional_info.subject: RE: ID0383166-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000835] Emergency stop ERROR Flag CRM:01251000918
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Customer has created the ticket for Emergency Stop error flag, Customer has also changed the emergency setting form SCB
I have checked by performing Hard reboot of the charger but error still persist.
There could be hardware wiring Issue, so Site intervention will be required.
Need to check below points:
1) Emergency Stop wiring connecting in charger
2) QA 26 Safety relay status & Interconnection if wiring
3) DI15(-F03-KF5) of PLC , wiring ,Connection & Status of DI & Q3(1/2)[-F03-KF10] wiring & connection.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma
